about_the_game:
The Snipers Pack is built for precision killers and stylish tacticians.

Includes:

🎯 Bulls Eye Cards x4,500 – Upgrade and sharpen your sniper skills.

🤠 "Yeehaw" Skin – Look cool while staying cold-blooded.

🧨 Helmet: Master of War – For the ones who lead from the shadows.

🚀 Jetpack: Cargo Green – Tactical mobility with a rugged edge.

💰 In-game coins  x100,000 – Stock up and gear out.

💎 Yeeters Bucks x5,000 – Premium funds for elite upgrades.

Stay sharp. Stay silent. Be the one shot they never see coming.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-6600K / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti / Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-10600K / Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 / Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Dominate from a distance with the Snipers Pack! Includes 4,500 Bulls Eye cards, "Yeehaw" skin, Master of War helmet, Cargo Green jetpack, 100,000 In-game coins, and 5,000 Yeeters Bucks. Strike silently, upgrade fast, and look deadly doing it.
